source: ChatGPT uploaded-only application review documents release
release_scope: Deploy current main including PR #216. The Application Review route no longer mounts IntermediaryDocumentReviewPortal, so the server-rendered review page is the single source of truth for document cards. Review now shows only genuinely uploaded documents in stable order, including one Education Marksheet, Signed Registration Certificate when uploaded, uploaded custom/Other Documents, and any remaining uploaded onboarding documents. Empty/optional placeholders are not generated. The editable Documents workflow and its 10-slot model remain unchanged.

Full lint/typecheck/build were not run for this PR. GitHub deployment workflow must succeed and Vercel must report READY for the exact resulting production deployment before production success is claimed.
